say:1:1320625001:1.text: Why isn't Callan responding to me?
say:1:1320625001:1.source_cn: 哥哥他……为什么不回应我呢？

say:2:1320625002:0.text: Perhaps the medium isn't important enough for Callan to awaken the remnants of his soul.
say:2:1320625002:0.source_cn: 或许是媒介对铐兰而言还不够重要，无法唤起他的残魂。

say:3:1320625003:1.text: If the family signet ring isn't important enough, what is?
say:3:1320625003:1.source_cn: 竟然连代表家族和身份的长子印戒都不够吗？

say:4:1320625004:0.text: The value of a medium cannot be judged in worldly terms. A dying flower can hold more significance than a jewel if it's dear to the soul in life.
say:4:1320625004:0.source_cn: 用以充当灵魂媒介的物品，其世俗意义上的价值毫无意义。只...

say:5:1320625005:1.text: Our home has been reduced to dust. After such a long time, I don't know what possessions my brother has left...
say:5:1320625005:1.source_cn: 我们的居所已经化为齑粉，过去了这么久，我不知道哥哥还有...

choice_prompt:6:1320625005.text: Our home has been reduced to dust. After such a long time, I don't know what possessions my brother has left...
choice_prompt:6:1320625005.source_cn: 我们的居所已经化为齑粉，过去了这么久，我不知道哥哥还有哪些重要的物事留存……

say:7:1320625006:0.text: "The Mage and the Adventurer"...? But that's just a fairy tale he wrote for me when I was young.
say:7:1320625006:0.male: "The Mage and the Adventurer"...? But that's just a fairy tale he wrote for me when I was young.
say:7:1320625006:0.female: "The Mage and the Adventurer"...? But that's just a fairy tale he wrote for me when I was young.

say:8:1320625007:1.text: My brother loved books all his life and wrote much more important works, such as the "Ducal Territory Act" for the Archduke and the "Song of St. Valesa," which explored the history of the temple.
say:8:1320625007:1.source_cn: 但它只是写给年幼的我的童话故事，哥哥一生爱书，他写过许...

say:9:1320625008:1.text: There were so many other documents and books that I can't even remember. They were all piled high on his desk. Callan always said he was proud of the power of his quill.
say:9:1320625008:1.source_cn: 还有好多好多我连名字也记不住，也无法理解的文书，它们在...

say:10:1320625009:1.text: And some of his great creations have now just disappeared on the bitter winter wind...
say:10:1320625009:1.source_cn: 但是那些我还未来得及理解的哥哥的伟大创作，已经随凛冽的...

choice_prompt:11:1320625009.text: And some of his great creations have now just disappeared on the bitter winter wind...
choice_prompt:11:1320625009.source_cn: 但是那些我还未来得及理解的哥哥的伟大创作，已经随凛冽的冬风消失了……

say:12:1320625010:3.text: Magister Merlin is absolutely right. What I hold dearest are my children, Hardhead and Whistler. If they left me, I wouldn't be able to go on.
say:12:1320625010:3.source_cn: 梅林说得对，我最珍重的是铁头尖哨这几个孩子，要让他们离...
say:12:1320625010:3.male: Magister Merlin is absolutely right. What I hold dearest are my children, Hardhead and Whistler. If they left me, I wouldn't be able to go on.
say:12:1320625010:3.female: Magister Merlin is absolutely right. What I hold dearest are my children, Hardhead and Whistler. If they left me, I wouldn't be able to go on.

say:13:1320625011:1.text: Even at the end of my life, they'll stay with me until we're nailed shut in our coffin and buried in the earth.
say:13:1320625011:1.source_cn: 哪怕到了生命的尽头，他们也会陪着我，直到被一起钉入棺材...

say:15:1320625012:1.text: Miss Carolina, we should really give it a try. It's Callan's love for you that kept his soul going for so long.
say:15:1320625012:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜小姐，或许你真的可以尝试一下，铐兰对你的爱让他...

say:16:1320625013:1.text: Compared to one's duties, when a soul is about to die, it is very natural for a person to want to return to their family.
say:16:1320625013:1.source_cn: 和工作与责任相比，一个灵魂将要逝去时，想要重新回到被家...

say:18:1320625015:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please take this letter and put it beside "The Mage and the Adventurer".
say:18:1320625015:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please take this letter and put it beside "The Mage and the Adventurer".
say:18:1320625015:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please take this letter and put it beside "The Mage and the Adventurer".

say:19:1320625016:1.text: I hope Callan will respond back this time...
say:19:1320625016:1.source_cn: 希望哥哥这次能回应我的呼唤……

choice:11:0:1.text: What he keeps with him is the most precious.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 他留在身边的才是最珍重的东西
choice:11:0:1.male: What he keeps with him is the most precious.
choice:11:0:1.female: What he keeps with him is the most precious.

choice:11:1:2.text: He always kept all your letters.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 但陪他长眠的是给你的信
choice:11:1:2.male: He always kept all your letters.
choice:11:1:2.female: He always kept all your letters.

choice:6:1:2.text: He left something just for you.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 他专门为你留下了东西
choice:6:1:2.male: He left something just for you.
choice:6:1:2.female: He left something just for you.
